# DriveSchoolPro

> Driving school management software for UK ADIs and driving schools — lesson scheduling, student management, DVSA competency tracking, and automated billing.

DriveSchoolPro helps independent driving instructors (ADIs) and driving school owners manage their business end-to-end. Tracks all 27 DVSA competency skills per student, automates lesson reminders to cut no-shows, and handles invoicing — so instructors can focus on teaching. Free during early access — until 31 March 2027. From 1 April 2027: a permanent Free plan (1 instructor, up to 60 lessons a month, every feature including AI lesson briefings), Solo £22/month, School £22/month + £10 per extra instructor. No VAT charged.

DriveSchoolPro is a product of JOHN POWELL LTD (company number 05408918, England and Wales). UK only. Web, iPhone and Android.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://driveschoolpro.com/): Product overview, feature highlights, testimonials, and free early access
- [Driving School Management Software](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-school-management-software/): Pupils, diary and payments in one place — scheduling, student management, DVSA tracking, billing, and reminders
- [Driving Instructor Diary App](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-instructor-diary-app/): ADI diary app for web, iPhone and Android — day/week/month views, drag-and-drop, clash checks across pupil, instructor and car, pupil records, card payments, automatic email reminders (text and WhatsApp coming soon), shared diary for multi-instructor schools
- [Free Driving School Software](https://driveschoolpro.com/free-driving-school-software/): DriveSchoolPro is free until 31 March 2027 with full feature access, no credit card required

From 1 April 2027: permanent Free plan (1 instructor, up to 60 lessons a month, every feature including AI), Solo £22/month, School £22/month + £10 per extra instructor. No VAT charged (JOHN POWELL LTD is not VAT-registered).

## DVSA Skills Reference

- [All 27 DVSA Driving Skills](https://driveschoolpro.com/dvsa-27-driving-skills/): Complete reference for all 27 DVSA competency skills with 5-level progression framework (Introduced → Reflection)
- [Basics (Skills 1–7)](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-skills/basics/): Controls, cockpit drill, moving off, and stopping
- [Observation & Signalling (Skills 8–13)](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-skills/observation-signalling/): MSM routine, mirrors, signals, anticipation, speed, and eco-driving
- [Junctions & Roundabouts (Skills 14–15)](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-skills/junctions-roundabouts/): T-junctions, crossroads, and roundabout technique
- [Pedestrian Crossings (Skill 16)](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-skills/following-routes/): Crossing types and pedestrian priority
- [Manoeuvres (Skills 17–21)](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-skills/manoeuvres/): Reversing, bay parking, parallel parking, turn in road
- [Road Types (Skills 22–24)](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-skills/road-types/): Dual carriageways, motorways, and country roads
- [Driving Conditions (Skills 25–27)](https://driveschoolpro.com/driving-skills/driving-conditions/): Night driving, adverse weather, and eco-safe driving
